issues.where: the sunset sky and the calm sea just under the horizon

issues.fix: add dither or grain to the horizon glow and sea and keep more bitrate in the dark low-contrast water

issues.where: the sea foam or cloud tops at the bottom right
issues.what: the fine frothy texture is smoothed into softer lumps; it still reads as foam
issues.fix: keep a little more high-frequency detail in the bright foam

issues.where: the thin smoke or vapour wisps and the orange muzzle glow to the right of the figure cluster

issues.where: the rock face texture on the left and the edges of the translucent ribbons
